plain_text:
John Dehner appears in 533 recordings across 21 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1947 to 1979. The credits here include performer, writer, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear John Dehner most often in Gunsmoke, Have Gun, Will Travel, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Escape, Frontier Gentleman, The Whistler, Fort Laramie, and Suspense.

Characters credited here include Paladin, J. B. Kendall, and Captain Lee Quince.
